"""
Working example of an IF...ELSE statement

1. Run the program and enter your age.
2. Try changing >= 18 to > 18 - what is different?
3. Try adding an elif to handle a different age group.
"""

age = int(input("Enter your age: "))

if age >= 18:
    print("You are old enough to vote.")
else:
    years_left = 18 - age
    print("You are not old enough to vote yet.")
    print("You need to wait " + str(years_left) + " more year(s).")
